reviewContext: Independent subagent with no builder turn history; screenshot-first review, then focused source inspection; no file edits or tests
objective: Expanded Spatial Library content browsing and checked placement while preserving the compact Library and canonical authoring flow

repairFindings: Place in Scene was too small and quiet beneath selected item details; selected model framing clipped a leg.
Phone initial view put empty details ahead of content, hid the category overflow cue and used a 22 by 22 pixel card action target.
Narrow desktop spent too much vertical space on controls and category tabs lacked arrow key behavior and a linked panel.

observations: Desktop Source, Show and Sort occupy a shorter top toolbar and Place in Scene is a full-width primary action.
Phone opens directly on cards, shows a category swipe cue, and reveals selected details and Place in Scene after selecting a card.
Card action targets are 38 by 38 pixels; tab source has roving focus, arrow, Home and End navigation and a linked tab panel.
The model has more framing room, although its near leg remains close to the preview edge.
finalReview.limits: Captured states cover one built-in asset placement path, not every content kind or long-detail state; review is not owner visual acceptance.
